_comment: The one place to change project status. status: Live | Next | Planned. Rendered by assets/site.js on Home and Projects.
engagement: One independent, simulated engagement for a fictional hotel group with two properties and synthetic data.

stages.name: Hotel Operations Knowledge Assistant
stages.summary: Cited, property-specific policy answers for front-desk staff.
stages.delivers: A live RAG assistant that answers front-desk policy questions from each hotel's own documents, cites every fact, refuses when the documents don't say and flags when to check with a manager. Measured on a 54-question eval and a 49-question visitor set.

stages.name: Guest Request Agent
stages.summary: Drafts replies to guest emails, with staff approval.
stages.delivers: An agent that reads guest emails, checks bookings and policy (using stage 1 as a tool), drafts a reply and waits for staff approval before anything is sent.

stages.name: Eval Harness
stages.delivers: A larger labeled test set, an LLM judge calibrated against human labels, and regression gates that block a worse release.

stages.name: Production Deployment
stages.delivers: Production limits made explicit: latency and cost budgets, personal-data redaction, authentication and a monitoring dashboard.

stages.name: Client Handoff
stages.summary: Docs and runbooks the team can own.
stages.delivers: Architecture docs, decision records, incident runbooks and a recorded walkthrough, so the client's team can run it without me.
